description: Land Settlement Department - Mullegama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520013
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and property characteristics) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses entirely on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
